definitions.gloss: straw bag; bale (for rice, charcoal, etc.)
definitions.explanation: A cylindrical sack woven from rice straw, traditionally used to hold and transport rice, charcoal, or potatoes. Also serves as a counter for such bagged goods ({一|いち}{俵|ぴょう}, {二|に}{俵|ひょう}).

examples.japanese: ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{俵|たわら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧。
examples.english: Pack the rice into straw bags.

examples.japanese: {俵|たわら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{担|かつ}いで→担ぐ：03917_katsugu⟧⟦{運|はこ}んだ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: He carried the straw bale on his shoulder.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{俵|たわら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詰|つ}めて→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧⟦{蔵|くら}→蔵：13991_kura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}した→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧。
examples.english: Farmers of old packed their harvested rice into straw bales and stored them in the storehouse.

notes:
A traditional agricultural container; the woven straw ring bordering a sumo ring (⟦{土俵|どひょう}→土俵：12010_dohyou⟧) is also made of these bales.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {米俵|こめだわら}: bag of rice
- {炭俵|すみだわら}: bag of charcoal
- {俵|たわら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧: to pack into a straw bag

USAGE:
Also works as a counter for bagged goods, with the sound shifting after some numbers: ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧{俵|ぴょう}, ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{俵|ひょう}, ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{俵|びょう}.
